# OCSP CertID issuer-match vectors: a DELEGATED responder (RFC 6960 4.2.2.2) whose certificate is
# validly issued by the real issuer, so signature, delegation and id-kp-OCSPSigning all pass and the
# CertID issuer name/key hash is the only guard left. EC P-256. Validity of every certificate
# 2020-01-01..2126-09-15; each response has thisUpdate = its generation time (2026-10-15 12:08:3xZ)
# and nextUpdate 2125-05-09, so tests pin a clock derived from the parsed thisUpdate.
#   ca_a_cert          - self-signed root (anchor and issuer of leaf_cert and delegate_cert), CN=TlsLib IssuerMatch CA A
#   ca_b_cert          - an unrelated root, CN=TlsLib IssuerMatch CA B (different name and key)
#   ca_a_rekeyed_cert  - CA A's subject DN under a DIFFERENT key (same name hash, different key hash)
#   ca_a_renamed_cert  - CA A's KEY under a different subject DN, CN=TlsLib IssuerMatch CA C (different name hash, same key hash)
#   leaf_cert          - serial 0x1001, SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth, issued by CA A
#   delegate_cert      - OCSP responder certificate, EKU id-kp-OCSPSigning, issued by CA A
# Every response is good, SHA-1 CertID, serial 0x1001 (the leaf's), signed by delegate_cert; only the CertID issuer hashes differ:
#   ocsp_delegated_good             - CA A: nameHash 726C8832..., keyHash D1F428E9... (control)
#   ocsp_delegated_wrong_certid     - CA B: nameHash 9476E513..., keyHash FDF841CC... (both differ)
#   ocsp_delegated_wrong_key_hash   - CA A rekeyed: nameHash 726C8832... (equal), keyHash 2C3D906C... (differs)
#   ocsp_delegated_wrong_name_hash  - CA A renamed: nameHash 17754CD6... (differs), keyHash D1F428E9... (equal)
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.6.1 (needs -not_before/-not_after; OPENSSL_CONF=<empty file>, MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*',
# NB=20200101000000Z, NA=21260915000000Z). Private keys are not kept in the repo:
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key         (X = caa, cab, caa2 (the rekeyed CA A), leaf, delegate)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key X.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib IssuerMatch CA S" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA
#     -addext basicConstraints=critical,CA:true -addext keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign,digitalSignature -addext subjectKeyIdentifier=hash -out cX.pem
#     (caa.pem: key caa, S=A; cab.pem: key cab, S=B; caa2.pem: key caa2, S=A; cac.pem: key caa, S=C)
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA cX.pem -CAkey K.key -set_serial 0x1001 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leafX.pem
#     (X = a, b, a2, c with K = the key of that CA; only leafa is stored, the others only build the requests)
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth / subjectAltName=DNS:localhost /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl req -new -key delegate.key -subj "/CN=TlsLib IssuerMatch Delegate" -out delegate.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in delegate.csr -CA caa.pem -CAkey caa.key -set_serial 2 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile delegate.ext -out delegate.pem
#     delegate.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=OCSPSigning / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   printf 'V\t21260915000000Z\t\t1001\tunknown\t/CN=localhost\n' > index.txt
#   openssl ocsp -issuer caX.pem -cert leafX.pem -no_nonce -reqout reqX.der
#   openssl ocsp -index index.txt -CA caX.pem -rsigner delegate.pem -rkey delegate.key -reqin reqX.der -ndays 36000 -respout RESP.der
#     (X = a: ocsp_delegated_good, b: ocsp_delegated_wrong_certid, a2: ocsp_delegated_wrong_key_hash, c: ocsp_delegated_wrong_name_hash)
#   openssl ocsp -respin X.der -resp_text -noverify   (decode: Certificate ID hashes, Serial Number 1001, Cert Status good)
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each *_cert field);  xxd -p X.der   (each ocsp_* field)
ca_a_
ca_b_
ca_a_rekeyed_
ca_a_renamed_
leaf_
delegate_
ocsp_delegated_
ocsp_delegated_wrong_
ocsp_delegated_wrong_key_
ocsp_delegated_wrong_name_
